title: Seven Palms Pinnacle | KEY.co
description_expanded: Spanning three floors, the sleeping arrangements are thoughtfully designed to accommodate various group dynamics in utmost comfort. The first floor introduces a luxurious king bedroom with a private bathroom, setting the stage for the opulent accommodations that unfold on the upper levels. The second floor features a master suite with a king bed and a private bath with a shower and a soaking tub, alongside additional king bedrooms and a bunk room, each with its own private bathroom. The third floor continues to impress with another king bedroom, a shared bathroom bunk room, and an additional king bedroom with a private bathroom, ensuring every guest experiences unparalleled comfort and privacy. This home is not just a place to stay; it’s a gateway to a memorable vacation filled with leisure, luxury, and the serene backdrop of the Gulf. This newly constructed vacation home offers an unparalleled blend of luxury and comfort, boasting breathtaking Gulf views and an array of amenities that cater to an exceptional holiday experience. With its private resort-style pool and spa, guests can indulge in an oasis of relaxation, with the option to heat the pool for cozy swims between October and May. The inclusion of a six-seater golf cart and six adult bicycles enhances the exploration experience, allowing easy access to the nearby beach. Complimentary beach setups, available from March through October, ensure a hassle-free seaside retreat. The property’s convenience is further amplified by an elevator, making every level of this splendid home effortlessly accessible.
